description: This Java class `ItemIdKeyProvider` extends `ItemKeyProvider<Long>` to provide item keys based on their IDs within a RecyclerView. It helps in managing item selections by mapping adapter item IDs to positions and vice versa, primarily used in selection operations within a RecyclerView in an Android application.

classes.name: ItemIdKeyProvider
classes.description: Provides item keys for RecyclerView items based on their IDs, facilitating selection management.

methods.name: ItemIdKeyProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a RecyclerView instance.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the item ID (key) for a given adapter position, throws exception if adapter is not set.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of an item for a given item ID (key), or NO_POSITION if not found.
